description: Synthetic Building Energy Consumption Dataset – Local Calendar Week Sampler (MODERATE Project) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Antonio Barion (Eindhoven University of Technology). This dataset contains 50 synthetic years of sub-hourly building energy and indoor environment data, generated from approximately 3 years of real monitored data using the Local Calendar Week Sampler method developed within the MODERATE project (Horizon Europe GA 101069834). Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
